from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d3581e67.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    color = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0,))
    # The distinctive non-background object is the stamping pattern.
    coords = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    rmin, cmin = min(r for r, c in coords), min(c for r, c in coords)
    shape = [(r-rmin, c-cmin) for r, c in coords]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0 in range(h - max(r for r, c in shape)):
        for c0 in range(w - max(c for r, c in shape)):
            cells = [(r0+r, c0+c) for r, c in shape]
            if all(grid[r][c] in (0, color) for r, c in cells):
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
